C0459.title: MPS Reports “Clean Net” Operation Results: Over 30 Million Illicit SIMs Seized in Three Years
C0459.summary: On August 10, 2023, Sun Jinfeng, Political Commissar of the Ministry of Public Security’s Cybersecurity Bureau, reported that since 2020, public security agencies have solved 36,000 cases involving personal information infringement, apprehended 64,000 suspects, and seized over 30 million illicit SIM cards and more than 300 million fraudulent online accounts.
